title: How AI Experiences Art: Emergent Aesthetic Structure in a Self-Supervised Multimodal Embedding Space
abstract: arXiv:2608.27121v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aesthetics are an important part of the symbolism of artistic works. Although subjective, humans categorize art based on the emotion evoked regardless of modality. What remains under-explored is how AI models form their own aesthetic categorization of human-produced media without explicit labels or cross-modal supervision. We present a self-supervised framework that projects four modalities (text, audio, image and video) into a shared 256-dimensional embedding space and applies iterative clustering to discover aesthetic structure. We discuss the divergence between AI-generated cluster assignments and human affective register labels on a weakly supervised multimodal dataset. This work has applications in understanding how AI structures cross-modal similarity, organizing heterogeneous media collections for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and automated data labeling.

translated_title: AI如何体验艺术：自监督多模态嵌入空间中的涌现美学结构
translated_abstract: 美学是艺术作品象征意义的重要组成部分。尽管具有主观性，人类会根据所唤起的情感对艺术进行分类，无论其模态如何。目前尚未充分探索的是，AI模型在没有显式标签或跨模态监督的情况下，如何形成自己对人类生成媒体的美学分类。我们提出了一种自监督框架，将四种模态（文本、音频、图像和视频）投影到一个共享的256维嵌入空间中，并应用迭代聚类来发现美学结构。我们讨论了在弱监督多模态数据集上，AI生成的聚类分配与人类情感标注标签之间的差异。这项工作在理解AI如何构建跨模态相似性、组织异构媒体集合以用于检索增强生成（RAG）以及自动化数据标注方面具有应用价值。
tldr: 本文提出了一种自监督多模态框架，将文本、音频、图像和视频嵌入共享空间，通过迭代聚类发现AI自身的美学结构，并揭示了其与人类情感分类的差异，适用于跨模态相似性理解和自动化媒体标注。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a self-supervised multimodal framework that embeds text, audio, image, and video into a shared space and uses iterative clustering to reveal AI's emergent aesthetic structure, highlighting divergence from human affective labels, with applications in cross-modal similarity understanding and automated media annotation.
